stories.title: Ex GF Ki Panty Utaar Ke Chut Chatne Wali Kahani
stories.excerpt: College ki purani premika Deepa, 38 saal ki widow, akele pan mein tadap rahi thi. Jab uska ex boyfriend Pallab Italy se laut ke usse milne aaya, to 25 saal purani yaadein phir se jaag uthi.
